Loupe's copybutton. A button that puts a text on the clipboard and shows that it did.

```jsx
<CopyButton variant="text">Example</CopyButton>
<CopyButton variant="icon">Example</CopyButton>
```

Variants: `text`, `icon`. States: hover, active.

Labels are sentence case and never end in a full stop. The component emits the real `lp-copy-button` classes of the app.
